test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: Eight friends – A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H were seated in a circular table facing centre. Two persons were seated between B and D. G and C were immediate neighbours. Two persons were seated between G and F. Neither B nor C was seated adjacent to D. One person was seated between D and E. H was seated second to the right of E. Who was seated second to the right of A?
solution:
1) Two persons were seated between B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d792b2a7efbd69dd22d937c9558a43d03aaecba004dd48a8cfdc59b8bd8c1010.png] 

2) One person was seated between D and E. H was seated second to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e41dc3c0af17921d7c5ca415d552f67deda8988eda16ba6fabe283b75a6dc5f.png] 

3) G and C were immediate neighbours. Two persons were seated between G and F. Neither B nor C was seated adjacent to D.

Hence, case 1 is invalid because two persons were seated between G and F. Neither B nor C was seated adjacent to D.

So, the final arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f188d6291d426cf84318c67c7496a3e2b453319f57b23725370e4743bf4e7f81.png] 

Hence, F was seated second to the right of A
